evidence.result: Cache ancestors must resolve identically and have the expected project-cache suffix. Existing file symlinks, nonregular leaves and multiply linked files are refused. Tree traversal does not follow directory links; package links must resolve within the extraction root.

gpgv with the Ubuntu archive keyring must exit successfully before InRelease SHA256/size is used. Packages.xz bytes must match that authenticated digest; selected package bytes must match index SHA256/size before dpkg-deb extraction. Redis package version is pinned; source filenames are constrained to safe pool .deb paths.

Extraction targets a freshly created private staging root. Existing installed trees are compared against verified staged bytes rather than extracted over. Publication is a same-cache rename; cleanup checks staging parent, resolved path and uid before removing it.

execFile and subprocess argument arrays avoid shell interpretation. Root execution is refused; no apt install, sudo, maintainer-script execution or service command exists. Output contains package provenance/version rather than generated application authority.
Signature/hash, extraction, unsafe-tree, mismatched-cache, cleanup and version-probe failures surface; no swallowed exceptions.

probes: Python AST parse passed without executing main; node --check scripts/install-redis.mjs passed.

Private disposable WSL helper probes passed: regular leaf allowed; symlink, hardlink and directory cache leaves denied; in-root package link described; escaping package link denied; multiply linked tree file denied. All fixtures were removed by TemporaryDirectory.
Source SHA256 values checked after probes and matched the initial reviewed values.

checked_claims.result: Pinned upstream source supports external PostgreSQL and external Redis selection versus embedded stores. The dossier correctly requires independent runtime evidence and preserves the ingress durability warning.
Pinned upstream implementation uses pgx and embedded Goose migrations; no unsupported whole-platform recovery claim is made.
Official Redis documentation supports AOF replay, the everysec loss window and fsync-before-reply behavior of always. The dossier correctly excludes host-wide failure qualification.

Installer implementation supports the signed metadata/package verification, staging, link checking and local extraction claims. First acquisition success and exact host inventory are historical satellite observations, not independently re-run evidence from this review.

refutation_notes: Post-extraction tree validation alone would not sandbox malicious upstream archive extraction. Here the extractor consumes packages already authenticated against the explicitly trusted Ubuntu signing authority, inside a fresh private stage. No attacker-controlled unsigned archive path reaches extraction.

Check-before-use filesystem checks do not isolate a concurrently malicious process running as the installer uid. The local first-party owner account and trusted executable search path/keyring are assumptions; these scripts do not claim hostile same-user OS containment.

InRelease signature verification establishes provenance, not archive freshness. Exact Redis version pinning is intentional; this review does not turn the installer into an automatic security-update mechanism.
not_reviewed: COR-04: no installer concurrency guarantee requested; private-cache same-user TOCTOU races are outside the stated threat model.
REU-01, REU-02 and HYG-04: repository-wide reuse/abstraction/API documentation review excluded by the explicitly scoped installer security request.
No full installer acquisition/re-extraction run or native Redis launch performed; helper/syntax probes do not replace root final installer reverification.
No new global SAST/SCA scanner was installed or claimed; audit uses source-to-sink review and harmless local probes.
Research Connect SDK declaration/bundler details, host inventory, prior acquisition transcripts, Ubuntu archive freshness and all runtime/persistence experiments were not independently re-executed.
Unfinished jobs-runtime implementation and the previously reported plan majors remain unreviewed and unresolved by this scoped pass.
